evidence.evidenceExists: Three users in a pilot program reported the same friction point within 48 hours of starting.
evidence.evidenceMissing: We do not yet have telemetry data on error rates or time-to-recovery for the reported friction.
assumptions: Users are not misreporting the friction; their reports are accurate.
The friction is not caused by a misconfiguration specific to the pilot environment.
evidence.uncertainty: We have not confirmed whether the observed friction persists across all operating systems.
evidence.disproofCriteria: If telemetry shows fewer than 5% of sessions hit this code path, the problem may be less widespread than reported.

problemDiscovery.problemName: Save operation takes longer than 2 seconds on large documents
problemDiscovery.whoHasThisProblem: Users editing documents with more than 500 paragraphs.
problemDiscovery.whyNow: Recently increased document size limits from 200 to 1000 paragraphs, exposing a latent performance bottleneck.
problemDiscovery.whyNotTrendy: Performance engineering is often neglected in favor of feature velocity; this problem is under-measured.
problemDiscovery.currentSolutions: Users manually split documents or disable real-time collaboration.
problemDiscovery.whyCurrentSolutionsFail: Manual splitting breaks collaboration workflows; disabling real-time sync undermines the product value proposition.
problemDiscovery.smallestNextResearchAction: Profile save-path for documents with 500-1000 paragraphs and collect latency histograms.
